description: We are AstroPedia. Our team is going to develop a interplanetary map which is efficient and one of a kind.
summary: An interactive Mars map where every crater, every elevation and every distance is NASA's own data — measured live, sourced openly, no install, no login. Developed for future mars exploration. Best and most efficient NASA data based interplanetary map.
details:
Explore the Red Planet with **Interplanetary Martian Map**, an interactive Mars website created by **Team AstroPedia**! 🚀🔴

Discover iconic landmarks, explore mission sites, and see how NASA imagery and scientific observations bring Mars closer to curious explorers.

🌌 *What you can explore:*
• An interactive 3D Mars globe
• Olympus Mons, Valles Marineris, and mission locations
• HiRISE close-ups and Viking/MOLA map layers
• Distance measurements between points on Mars
• Archived InSight and delayed Curiosity weather observations
• NASA Deep Space Network communication reports
• A solar-system view with approximate planetary distances
• NASA’s image and video archives

🔗 *Try the website:* https://mars-gis-map.vercel.app/

*Data and imagery credits:* NASA, JPL-Caltech, USGS, Esri, University of Arizona, and MSSS. Globe rendering: CesiumJS.

Created by Team AstroPedia. This is an independent project, not an official NASA product.
